question: Which committee suggested that paying taxes should also be a fundamental duty of citizens
solution:
The correct answer is the __Swaran Singh Committee.__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Fundamental Duties of citizens were incorporated into the Constitution of India.
 
• This addition was based on the recommendations of the Swaran Singh Committee.
 
• The committee, chaired by Swaran Singh, was tasked with studying the feasibility of including Fundamental Duties.
 
• The 42nd Amendment Act of 1976 introduced these Fundamental Duties to the Indian Constitution.
 
• These duties emphasize the responsibilities of citizens towards the nation's integrity, harmony, and progress.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bhuta Singh Committee** (1988)

 
 
• The **Bhuta Singh Committee** was formed in **1988** to review the **backward classes** and their conditions.
 
• The committee was tasked with examining the **reservation system** and evaluating the **socio-economic status** of backward classes, particularly **Scheduled Castes (SCs), Scheduled Tribes (STs), and Other Backward Classes (OBCs)**.
 
• It focused on ensuring that the benefits of reservations were reaching the economically and socially disadvantaged sections of society, in accordance with the constitutional mandate
 
 
 
• **Charan Singh Committee (1979)**
 
 
• The **Charan Singh Committee** was established in **1979** under the chairmanship of **Charan Singh**, who was the then **Union Minister for Home Affairs**.
 
• The committee was set up to review the **Working of the Government of India** and recommend improvements. Its major contribution was in areas like **land reforms**, **economic issues**, and **the agrarian sector**.
 
• The committee was also instrumental in analyzing the structure and impact of existing policies related to agriculture and rural development.
 
 
 
• **J.S. Verma Committee (2012)**
 
 
• The **J.S. Verma Committee** was set up in **2012** by the Government of India in the aftermath of the **2012 Delhi gang rape case** (also known as the **Nirbhaya case**).
 
• The committee was tasked with reviewing the **laws related to sexual violence** and making recommendations to strengthen them.
 
• Chaired by former **Chief Justice of India, J.S. Verma**, the committee's report made important recommendations
